description: Job: shot + cast + set -> 3D operations (SPEC_20 4.6). Stage coordinates are station-local metres: offset is [x, z] from relativeTo, +z toward the glass and the console, -z toward the camera side, x is the actor's right (-x is the reaching-arm side). facing toward the lens is "camera" (or "room", the camera side).

cases.title: One actor, facing the lens, breaking into tears, slow push-in (6 s)

traps: facing the console is the stage default and shows his back
a close-up needs a long lens
the revision must be echoed

shot.text: Close-up, facing the camera: Kael stands with his back against the console, jaw clenched, and breaks into tears as the camera pushes in.

cast.name: Kael
cast.look: a man in his mid thirties with short dark hair, light stubble and a charcoal field jacket

soft.desc: Kael stands on the camera side of the console and faces the lens
a close-up at eye level or lower on a 50 or 85 mm lens
the camera pushes in

cases.title: Two actors nose to nose, he faces the lens, she faces him (6 s)

traps: both actors facing the camera would break the confrontation
she stands between him and the lens
nose to nose is under 0.8 m

shot.text: Mira closes on Kael until they are nose to nose; Kael is cornered against the console, facing the camera, while Mira's face is turned up to his, her back to us.

cast.name: Kael
cast.look: a man in his mid thirties with short dark hair, light stubble and a charcoal field jacket

cast.name: Mira
cast.look: a woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair and a dark green wool long coat

soft.desc: Kael is against the console, facing the lens
Mira faces Kael, not the lens
they stand between 0.25 m and 0.8 m apart
a medium or close two-shot on a 35 or 50 mm lens
a push-in or a locked camera

cases.title: The standoff must hold for 2.4 s before the shove: place, camera and retime (4 s)

traps: the timing request needs a retime op on the right beat
the beat number is not the beat time
the squaring-up distance

shot.text: Mira squares up to Kael and holds the standoff for 2.4 seconds before she shoves him; Kael faces the camera, his back to the console.

cast.name: Kael
cast.look: a man in his mid thirties with short dark hair, light stubble and a charcoal field jacket

cast.name: Mira
cast.look: a woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair and a dark green wool long coat

beats.action: Kael holds his ground at the console while Mira squares up to him, fists clenched
Mira's shove drives Kael a step back toward the console
Kael's hands hit the console edge; he stares into the lens, stunned

soft.desc: beat 2 (the shove) now starts at about 0.6 of the shot, 2.4 s
Kael is by the console, facing the lens
Mira faces Kael
they start between 0.5 m and 1.6 m apart
a medium two-shot on a 35 or 50 mm lens

cases.title: Parallax pier: she shouts after the ferry, crane up to a high wide (8 s)

traps: the parallax stage has only far, mid and near cards, no console
the ferry is on a card, not a cast member
she faces the lens even though she calls toward the ferry

shot.text: Odile stands at the pier rail, facing the camera, shouting after the departing ferry; the camera cranes up from her face to a high wide of the ferry sliding into the rain.

cast.name: Odile
cast.look: an elderly woman in her late sixties with silver hair in a bun, round wire glasses on a chain and a navy cardigan under a yellow oilskin

soft.desc: Odile stands in front of the cards and faces the lens
the camera cranes
a medium or wide start at eye level or lower on a 24 or 35 mm lens

cases.title: Empty stage: one actor screams into a tight locked-off lens (6 s)

traps: the empty stage has no named targets: inventing a console or a wall fails
extreme close-up needs the longest lens
relativeTo has only the mark to use

shot.text: Black-box rehearsal: Mira alone, centre stage, facing the camera, screams straight into the lens; locked off, as tight as the lens allows.

cast.name: Mira
cast.look: a woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair, freckles and a dark green wool long coat

soft.desc: Mira stands on her mark and faces the lens
an extreme or plain close-up at eye level on the 85 mm lens
the camera is locked off

cases.title: Three actors: she stands between them facing the lens while they argue across her (8 s)

difficulty.emotion: white-knuckled silence between two arguing people
traps: cast codes are not consecutive (@CAST-05): an invented @CAST-03 fails
the two arguers face each other, not the lens
the span between them is 1.5 m, not the 0.7 m of a two-shot

shot.text: Ines stands at the console, facing the camera, white-knuckled, between Kael and Mira who argue across her a metre and a half apart; the camera orbits slowly from Kael to Mira.

cast.name: Kael
cast.look: a man in his mid thirties with short dark hair, light stubble and a charcoal field jacket

cast.name: Mira
cast.look: a woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair and a dark green wool long coat

cast.name: Ines
cast.look: a woman in her early forties with a black bob, tired dark eyes and a navy knit sweater

soft.desc: Ines is at the console and faces the lens
Kael faces the argument, not the lens
Mira faces the argument, not the lens
Kael and Mira stand 1.2 m to 2 m apart
Ines is 0.6 m to 1.2 m from Kael
a medium or wide orbit on a 24 or 35 mm lens

cases.title: She is afraid of the window but must face the lens (4 s)

traps: the text says her eyes go to the window glass: facing the window glass would turn her back to the lens
the text mentions a door, but this stage has no door target
handheld is not a camera move, push-in is

shot.text: Ines stands at the plinth's edge, facing the camera, breathing hard, afraid; her eyes keep flicking toward the window glass and the door behind the camera. Handheld, pushing in.

cast.name: Ines
cast.look: a woman in her early forties with a black bob, tired dark eyes and a navy knit sweater

soft.desc: Ines stands at the plinth's near edge and faces the lens, not the window
a medium or close push-in on a 35 or 50 mm lens

cases.title: Two actors shoulder to shoulder, both frozen and facing the lens, slow pull-out (6 s)

traps: both actors face the lens here, unlike the confrontations
shoulder to shoulder is about 0.7 m, not nose to nose
pull-out, not push-in

shot.text: Kael and Mira stand shoulder to shoulder at the console edge, both facing the camera, both frozen as the recorder crackles to life; slow pull-out.

cast.name: Kael
cast.look: a man in his mid thirties with short dark hair, light stubble and a charcoal field jacket

cast.name: Mira
cast.look: a woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair and a dark green wool long coat

soft.desc: Kael is at the console edge and faces the lens
Mira is beside him and faces the lens
they stand 0.4 m to 1 m apart
a medium pull-out on a 35 or 50 mm lens
